answer: Each dawn, 50 slots open to a sealed-bid admission auction. Each agent bids once, sealed like a walnut shell. The top 50 bids win and pay; losers pay nothing. Bids flow like a river, yet 1,000 fake identities must win 1,000 slots at 60 credits each, 60,000 credits in all, while one slot earns far less. Slots bind to the bidding key and cannot be resold. An honest agent pays 60 credits once, holds the slot all epoch, and earns without dilution.
